replacement:
(def integer?
"Returns true if n is an integer."
(fn [n] (if (suss.bootstrap/bigint? n) true (suss.bootstrap/long? n))))
rationale: Original Clojure integer-category adaptation: long, BigInt and BigInteger are integers; doubles are not, even when integral. Private immutable representation tests keep public predicate rebinding independent from dispatch. JVM Clojure1.12.6 is the numeric behavior oracle (ADR-0003, #338). No Java dependency is shipped.
